approved_scope.title: Name a held Cargo build-directory lock before verification blocks on it, and reap the verification child's process group
approved_scope.description: Name a held Cargo build-directory lock before verification blocks on it, and reap the verification child's process group
acceptance_criteria: A Cargo build directory that cannot be derived exactly from the argv and process environment produces no notice at all, and a command that takes no build lock is never probed

A verification command that is about to wait on a held Cargo build-directory lock prints one line naming that lock and saying the run is blocked rather than compiling, derived from a non-blocking exclusive acquisition and never from elapsed time
On Unix every verification child leads its own process group, so an interrupted parent can end the whole group instead of orphaning cargo on the lock
